Bachelorette Party Scottsdale: Complete Planning Guide

Scottsdale has become the ultimate bachelorette party destination, offering the perfect mix of relaxation, adventure, and nightlife. Here's your complete planning guide.

Bachelorette Party Scottsdale Guide

Scottsdale has become the ultimate bachelorette party destination, offering the perfect mix of relaxation, adventure, and nightlife. Here's your complete planning guide.

Why Bachelorette Parties Love Scottsdale

  • World-class spas - Sanctuary, Civana, The Phoenician
  • Pool party scene - W Scottsdale, Talking Stick
  • Shopping - Fashion Square, Kierland Commons
  • Instagrammable everything - Pink walls, desert sunsets
  • Vibrant nightlife - Old Town entertainment district

Sample Weekend Itinerary

Friday: Arrival & Chill

  • 3:00 PM: Check into Airbnb or boutique hotel
  • 5:00 PM: Pool time and champagne
  • 7:00 PM: Dinner at The Mission
  • 9:30 PM: Bar hopping in Old Town
  • 12:00 AM: Return for late-night swim

Saturday: Spa to Party

Daytime

  • 10:00 AM: Group spa treatment at Sanctuary
  • 1:00 PM: Brunch at The Henry
  • 3:00 PM: Pool party at W Scottsdale

Evening

  • 6:00 PM: Glam session at hotel
  • 8:00 PM: Dinner at Olive & Ivy
  • 10:00 PM: Party bus to clubs
  • 2:00 AM: Late-night pizza

Sunday: Brunch & Goodbye

  • 11:00 AM: Bottomless brunch at Hash Kitchen
  • 2:00 PM: Last pool time
  • 4:00 PM: Departures

Transportation Must-Haves

Party Bus Benefits

  • Keeps the group together
  • Music, drinks, and dancing en route
  • Perfect for Instagram stories
  • VIP arrival at venues
  • Safe rides all night

Popular Routes

  • Hotel to Old Town Scottsdale
  • Pool party hopping (W, Talking Stick, The Scott)
  • Wine tour to Verde Valley
  • Day trip to Sedona

Budget Per Person (2 nights)

  • Accommodations: $150-300
  • Spa day: $150-250
  • Dining: $150-200
  • Nightlife: $100-250
  • Activities: $75-150
  • Transportation share: $50-100
  • Total: $675-1,250 per person

Planning Tips

  1. Create a shared fund - Collect money upfront for group expenses
  2. Book spa early - Group appointments need advance notice
  3. Match the bride's vibe - Chill or crazy? Plan accordingly
  4. Pack for heat - Even pool covers should be cute
  5. Have a backup plan - Indoor activities for rare rainy days

Photo Op Locations

  • Sunshine & Succulents (pink wall)
  • Desert Botanical Garden
  • Papago Park sunset
  • Old Town murals
  • Resort pool cabanas
